{{Quote|The previous commander of Coruscant Security also made demands for more soldiers, Moff Kadir. You shall make do with what we provide. Unless you'd rather share your predecessor's fate.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="SWEBpart1" />}}
[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kadir (Moff)|Kadir's]] '''father''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Kadir" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]], served as the [[Commander of Coruscant Security|Commander]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWEBpart1" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he<ref name="Kadir" /> was [[Death/Legends|executed]] for voicing his opinions too much by requesting more [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to secure the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SWEBpart1" /> He was replaced as the commander of Coruscant Security by his [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] Kadir.<ref name="Kadir" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kadir's [[Parent/Legends|father]] was first mentioned in [[Empire 1|''Empire'' 1]], written by [[Scott Allie]] as the first issue in the ''[[Star Wars: Empire]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="SWEBpart1" /> on [[September 4]], [[2002]].<ref name="Release">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54175/star_wars_empire_2002_1|text=Star Wars: Empire (2002) #1}}</ref> Although originally only identified as Moff Kadir's predecessor in ''Empire'' 1,<ref name="SWEBpart1" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' further stated that he was Moff Kadir's father.<ref name="Kadir" />
